q1: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON WHERE NAME NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT NAME FROM SALESPERSON WHERE SALES_ID IN (SELECT SALES_ID FROM ORDERS WHERE COM_ID IN (SELECT COM_ID FROM COMPANY WHERE NAME='RED')))
